verdict.rationale: Asana's App Directory lists integrations offering real-time two-way sync between Asana tasks and GitLab issues, plus one-way or two-way sync with GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket, so the story is deliverable. However, these appear to be directory listings rather than clearly first-party native features, and the GitHub-specific listing only syncs pull request status one way into Asana. missing for 10: evidence of a native first-party bi-directional sync with GitHub/GitLab issues, documentation of field mapping and conflict handling, independent or hands-on corroboration that the sync works as described.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data

citations.quote: Turn GitLab issues into Asana tasks and back with real-time 2-way sync without writing a single line of code.
Keep teams aligned with automated one-way or two-way data synchronization — without manual updates or switching tools.
Integrate Bitbucket with Asana to sync issues, tasks, projects, repos, comments, assignees, custom fields, and more, automatically.
